title: Ventral Midbrain Dopaminergic Neuron Monolayer Differentiation Protocol
author: Yu Chen
materials: Day 25: mDAN progenitor seeding for maturation.

steps.title: Prepare Geltrex-coated plates
steps.instruction: Coat plates with Geltrex diluted in DMEM/F12 media at a 1:100 ratio.

substeps.instruction: Use 1 mL of diluted Geltrex for each well of a 6-well plate.
Incubate plates at 37 °C for at least 1 hour.

steps.title: Prepare Neural Induction Media (NIM) + CEPT
steps.instruction: Prepare NIM with the following components for a 500 mL batch: Neurobasal (500 mL), N2 supplement (5 mL), B27 supplement w/o Vitamin A (10 mL), Glutamax (5 mL), LDN193189 (250 nM), A83-01 (2 uM), SHH-C24II (250 ng/mL), SAG 21k (2 uM), and CHIR99021 (0.75 uM).

substeps.instruction: Note: 4 mL of this media is required to seed 4 million iPSCs in one well of a 6-well plate.

steps.title: Seed iPSCs (Day 0)
steps.instruction: Dissociate iPSCs using Accutase and seed them onto Geltrex-coated plates in NIM + CEPT.

substeps.instruction: Seed at a density of 400k cells/cm².

steps.title: Maintain iPSCs (Days 1-3)
steps.instruction: Perform a complete medium change daily using 4 mL of NIM per well of a 6-well plate.

steps.title: Apply CHIR boost (Days 4-7)
steps.instruction: Perform a complete medium change daily using 4 mL of NIM + CHIR boost per well of a 6-well plate.

steps.title: Apply CHIR boost only (Days 8-9)
steps.instruction: Perform a complete medium change daily using 4 mL of CHIR boost per well of a 6-well plate.

steps.title: Switch to Neural Patterning Media (Day 10)
steps.instruction: Perform a complete medium change using 4 mL of NPM + CHIR Boost per well of a 6-well plate.

steps.title: Plate mDAN progenitors (Day 11)
steps.instruction: Dissociate mDAN progenitors with Accutase by incubating for 10 minutes at 37 °C.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend progenitors in NPM + CHIR Boost + CEPT.
Seed onto Geltrex-coated plates at a density of 800k cells/cm².

steps.title: Feed mDAN progenitors (Day 12)
steps.instruction: Perform a complete medium change using 4 mL of NPM + CHIR Boost per well of a 6-well plate.

steps.title: Maintain mDAN progenitors (Days 13-24)
steps.instruction: Perform a complete medium change daily using 4 mL of NPM per well of a 6-well plate.

substeps.instruction: Optional: mDAN progenitors can be frozen at day 16 in STEM-CELLBANKER at 10 to 30 million per mL.

steps.title: Prepare Cultrex-coated plates
steps.instruction: Coat plates with Cultrex diluted in DMEM/F12 media at a 1:100 ratio.

substeps.instruction: Use 1 mL of diluted Cultrex for each well of a 6-well plate.
Incubate plates at 37 °C for at least 1 hour.

steps.title: Plate mDAN progenitors on Cultrex
steps.instruction: Dissociate mDAN progenitors with Accutase by incubating for 10 minutes at 37 °C.

substeps.instruction: Seed onto Cultrex-coated plates at a density of 50k to 200k cells/cm².

steps.title: Maturation feeding (Day 25 onward)
steps.instruction: Feed cells every 72 hours with NPM for maturation.
